title: Rust Python Extension Evaluation Report
reason: L6 profiling identified no pure Python CPU leaf hotspots; FFI boundary overhead and packaging complexity outweigh potential performance gains.

candidateEvaluations.candidate: PyO3 / Maturin Document Parsing Leaf Extension
candidateEvaluations.rationale: High engineering risk of OCR/table parsing regressions; PyTorch memory retention is not solved by FFI leaf optimization.

candidateEvaluations.candidate: PyO3 Text Tokenization / Chunking Leaf Extension
candidateEvaluations.rationale: Operation takes <1.5 ms in pure Python; PyO3 CPython GIL acquire + PyString conversion overhead negates execution savings.

packagingImpact.crossCompilationComplexity: HIGH (requires Windows x64/ARM64 maturin cross-compilation toolchain)
packagingImpact.toolchainRequirement: Cargo / Rust compiler (not installed on build runner)

verdict.action: Halt PyO3 Rust extension implementation; rely on worker process recycling and lazy dependency imports per L6 scorecard recommendations.
